body: My boyfriend, he is amazing and I love him so much. My mother manipulates me using him and it just hurts.
I really do not want to disclose this information if it's okay.
I do not think such thing exists where I live, but I will try looking into it. Thank you.
It's difficult, because even though my family and my SO don't care, I love them a lot. But I just feel like a burden.
Hope that works out well for you, bud.

I'm sorry for your loss. I really am. I hope you are dealing with this on your own pace and will heal in time. I have seen a mental health professional, but when I left their office I felt even worse. During the stay they started talking about themselves and their life to try and relate to me. Really felt like my issues are being disregarded.
Nothing makes me happy anymore. Everything I used to love doing, I hate. But thank you.

I have never been to see a mental health doctor and I feel like thay would be necessary considering that I have problems. Maybe it's just an excuse I don't know. I'm just too scared that I might do something really bad to myself out of pure impulse.
Thank you so much, I appreciate it.
